scientific_scope.R1: d<=7, finite pair-free bipartite gadget, actual valid-simple substitution into pair-free loopless d-regular labelled skeleton: actual substituted graph is pair-free, locally finite and d-regular, and bipartite if the skeleton is.
scientific_scope.R1_broader_model: The contraction theorem also allows heterogeneous copy fibers and infinite ambient skeletons; cycles always have finite support and finite labelled edge sets.
scientific_scope.B6: Every NONEMPTY FINITE SIMPLE BIPARTITE SIX-REGULAR graph has a pair iff every such graph has a pair avoiding EACH prescribed vertex.

limitations: The equivalence does not assert that its two equivalent universal degree-six statements are true.
Formal verification does not determine independent novelty, priority, awards, or progress against the original four-regular Erdos585 target.
All failed elaboration attempts remain failed historical evidence; their recovery sorryAx prints are never promoted.
